motivation: Discovery V1 suggested that future front-end persistence was associated with positive 3m FX follow-through, but that classification used the next observation and is therefore not tradable at the current decision time. V2 replaces it with persistence already observable at time t.

eligibility.current_state: CONTRADICTORY under the unchanged alignment contract
eligibility.current_front_end_sign: non-zero sign of current local-minus-USD 2Y repricing
eligibility.previous_front_end_sign: sign of immediately previous OOS observation for the same currency
eligibility.KNOWN_PERSISTENCE_AT_T: current and previous front-end signs are both non-zero and equal
eligibility.NO_KNOWN_PERSISTENCE_AT_T: previous sign is zero or different from current sign

outcomes.signed_fx_return_1m: current front-end sign multiplied by current OOS target_return
outcomes.signed_fx_return_3m: current front-end sign multiplied by the sum of target_return at t, t+1 and t+2 for the same currency
outcomes.minimum_remaining_horizon_for_3m: three target_return observations including current t

candidate_generation_rules.purpose: Decide only whether this mechanism deserves a separately predeclared future unseen-data test.

future_confirmation.data: strictly unseen observations after the historical discovery cutoff
